definition: Total gross revenue from the 1st of the current calendar month to today. Calculated as SUM(MrpValue) on VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT where CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AND CAST(XnDt AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date).
sql_pattern: SUM([MrpValue]) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)

definition: Total gross revenue from April 1 of the current Indian Financial Year to today. Indian FY runs April 1 to March 31. SUM(MrpValue) on VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT.
sql_pattern: SUM([MrpValue]) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE())>=4 THEN YEAR(GETDATE()) ELSE YEAR(GETDATE())-1 END, 4, 1) AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)

definition: Total gross revenue from the start of the current Indian FY quarter to today. Indian quarters: Q1=Apr-Jun, Q2=Jul-Sep, Q3=Oct-Dec, Q4=Jan-Mar. SUM(MrpValue) on VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT.
sql_pattern: SUM([MrpValue]) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (4,5,6) THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),4,1) WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (7,8,9) THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),7,1) WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (10,11,12) THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),10,1) ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),1,1) END AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)

definition: Total gross revenue for today only. SUM(MrpValue) on VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT where CAST(XnDt AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date).
sql_pattern: SUM([MrpValue]) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)

definition: Total gross revenue for yesterday. SUM(MrpValue) on VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT where CAST(XnDt AS date) = DATEADD(day, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)).
sql_pattern: SUM([MrpValue]) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) = DATEADD(day, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))

definition: Gross revenue for the same period in the previous year. Subtract 1 from YEAR() in the WHERE clause. Use SUM(MrpValue) on VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT.
sql_pattern: SUM([MrpValue]) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WHERE YEAR(CAST([XnDt] AS date))=YEAR(GETDATE())-1 AND MONTH(CAST([XnDt] AS date))=MONTH(GETDATE())

definition: Primary revenue metric. Use SUM(MrpValue) on dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT. MrpValue is the gross sales value column. NEVER use SaleNetAmount, NetSlsNetAmount, NetAmount, or any other revenue column — only MrpValue on this view.
sql_pattern: SUM([MrpValue]) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)
strict_rule: ALWAYS use MrpValue on VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT. Never use SaleNetAmount, NetSlsNetAmount, or any other column name.

definition: Today's footfall / bill count: SUM(BillCount) on dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT where CAST(XnDt AS date) = today. For invoice-level detail on APP_REPORT use COUNT(DISTINCT XnNo) only when XnNo is populated.
sql_pattern: CAST(SUM(ISNULL([BillCount],0)) AS BIGINT) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)

definition: Average revenue per invoice. = SUM(MrpValue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT XnNo), 0). Use NULLIF to avoid divide by zero.
sql_pattern: SUM([MrpValue]) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]), 0) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)

definition: Total quantity/pieces sold. Use SUM(AppQty) on VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT. AppQty is the quantity column.
sql_pattern: SUM([AppQty]) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)

definition: Branches ranked by gross revenue. GROUP BY BranchAlias, ORDER BY SUM(MrpValue) DESC. Use VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT. BranchAlias is the branch/store name column. Never use BranchId or BranchName.
sql_pattern: SELECT [BranchAlias] AS Branch, SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY [BranchAlias] ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

definition: Salespersons ranked by gross revenue. Use SupplierName column from VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT — no JOIN needed. GROUP BY SupplierName, ORDER BY SUM(MrpValue) DESC.
sql_pattern: SELECT [SupplierName] AS Salesperson, SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY [SupplierName] ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
strict_rule: Use SupplierName from VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT. No JOINs needed. Never use VwAISalesData or VwAISalesPerson.

definition: Product categories ranked by gross revenue or quantity. Use CategoryShortName on VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT. Never use CategoryId or CategoryName.
sql_pattern: SELECT [CategoryShortName] AS Category, SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY [CategoryShortName] ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

definition: Departments ranked by gross revenue. Use DepartmentShortName on VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT. Never use DepartmentId or DepartmentName.
sql_pattern: SELECT [DepartmentShortName] AS Department, SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY [DepartmentShortName] ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

definition: Articles ranked by quantity or revenue. Use ArticleNo from VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT (no ArticleName column). AppQty = quantity, MrpValue = revenue.
sql_pattern: SELECT [ArticleNo], SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty, SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY [ArticleNo] ORDER BY TotalQty DESC

definition: Current physical stock quantity at branches. Use StockQty from VW_MB_POWERBI_STOCK_REPORT.
sql_pattern: SUM(StockQty) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_STOCK_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK)

definition: Stock dispatched from one branch but not yet received at destination. Use GitQty from VW_MB_POWERBI_CBS_WITH_GIT.
sql_pattern: SUM(GitQty) FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_CBS_WITH_GIT WITH (NOLOCK)

definition: Total purchase amount from suppliers. Use SUM(NetPurNetAmount) on VW_MB_POWERBI_PURXNS_REPORT (or PurchasePrice×PurQty on SUPPLIER_PUR_REPORT). PUR_REPORT has PurQty only — not MrpValue.
sql_pattern: SELECT [SupplierName] AS Vendor, SUM([NetPurNetAmount]) AS TotalPurchase FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PURXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY [SupplierName] ORDER BY TotalPurchase DESC

definition: Customers registered in a given period. Use CreatedOn from VwAICustomerDetails.
sql_pattern: COUNT(*) FROM dbo.VwAICustomerDetails WHERE CreatedOn >= <start_date>

definition: Customers with birthday in the current month. Filter by MONTH(BirthdayDt) = MONTH(GETDATE()). NEVER filter by year — birthday year is birth year, not current year.
sql_pattern: WHERE MONTH(BirthdayDt) = MONTH(GETDATE())

definition: Percentage of purchased stock that has been sold. = Net Sales Qty / Purchase Qty * 100.
sql_pattern: SUM(AppQty) / NULLIF(SUM(PurQty), 0) * 100
